Starts a background process to keep the application alive by simulating user activity.

Summary: Starts a background process to keep the application alive by simulating user activity.

Description: This function is designed to prevent the application from being considered idle by simulating user interactions. It runs an infinite loop that moves the mouse in a square pattern and performs a click every 20 seconds. This is useful for applications that require continuous user interaction to avoid being terminated by the operating system due to inactivity.
</DOCSTRING>
